scope: Observed 2019 BMW; rules must not be generalized to other ECUs without evidence.
convention: OBDb fmt.nullmin and fmt.nullmax apply inclusive bounds to decoded values, not exact raw equality. No unsupported sentinel fields are added to the signal set.
review_policy: Retain raw captures and record missing-data values separately from numeric zero. Confirm before adding a filter; log ambiguous candidates without nulling them. Existing lambda/catalyst rules are recorded with their uncertainty, not newly certified.
